entities.summary: Large-scale political entities that have dominated human history, from the Akkadian Empire (c. 2334 BCE) through modern colonial empires. Empires arise through military conquest, diplomatic marriage, economic leverage, or cultural prestige, and their rise and fall patterns — overextension, succession crises, peripheral revolts — recur across civilizations and centuries.
